title: MiniMax M3
brief: MiniMax's M3 announcement — frontier coding capability, 1M context, native multimodality, and a new MSA architecture. All vendor claims, unverified.
details: MiniMax M3 is MiniMax's open-weight frontier model for coding and agentic work, combining frontier-level coding (59.0% SWE-Bench Pro, 66.0% Terminal-Bench 2.1), a 1M-token context window via the new MSA sparse-attention architecture, and native multimodality including image/video input and desktop computer operation. MSA makes per-token compute at 1M context just 1/20th of the previous generation, with 9x faster prefilling and 15x faster decoding. Available through MiniMax Code (their co-trained agent product), Token Plans ($20–$120/mo tiers), and API with standard and long-context pricing.
